summary.text: Patrick Brennan is the Republican incumbent state senator for the Grand Isle District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A convenience store owner, he served in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2003 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Brennan was born in Burlington, Vermont, and graduated from Rice Memorial High School.
He has served as a justice of the peace and a Colchester High School key communicator, and he is a member of the Colchester Republican Committee.
Brennan took office in the state Senate on January 8, 2025, after more than two decades in the Vermont House.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Senate Appropriations Committee and the Economic Development, Housing and General Affairs Committee, where he is vice chair of each, and the Senate Transportation Committee.
